messages:
Jessi Chen: FYI — Customer 'HexaMed' flagged invoice is blocked. Procurement says they need an "authorization code" (not just a PO number) before we can issue legal invoices. Shared their procurement email below.

Sam Patel: ugh. do we have anything like that in their contract? account id 89324, SOW v2 attached in SF.

Marta Gomez: procurement email says: "Our ERP requires AUTH-CODE + official PO formatted as: AUTH-<6 digits>-PO. Invoices without AUTH-CODE will be rejected."

Rajiv Kumar: can we issue a proforma for now? finance usually allows proforma but needs note: "Pending AUTH-CODE from purchaser" :thinking_face:

invoice-bot: Payment hold created for account 89324 — reason: customer_procurement_requires_authcode — ticket #INC-2024-5412

Sam Patel: finance (cc @Marta) says legal needs the exact procurement clause. Jessi, can you paste the customer's procurement snippet here or forward the email?

Jessi Chen: pasted snippet:

> "All invoices must contain the Procurement Authorization Code (format AUTH-XXXXXX). No invoice will be processed or paid without this code."

Jessi Chen: steps proposed:
1) Ask sales to request AUTH-CODE from customer (Rajiv) 2) If ETA > 5 business days, issue proforma invoice with note and start trial billing hold 3) Finance to flag account so we don't auto-send final invoice until code is received

Rajiv Kumar: I'll ping their procurement lead now. @Sam @Marta — if they push back on proforma, let me know wording they need.

Marta Gomez: finance approves proforma but needs these exact fields: Invoice#, Amount, Currency, "Proforma - Pending AUTH-CODE <placeholder>", and link to SOW. They will not forward to AR without AUTH.

Sam Patel: added assignment: Rajiv -> get AUTH-CODE; Marta -> prepare proforma template; Jessi -> update support ticket with blocking reason and copy procurement email. I'll mark this high priority.

Jessi Chen: done. Updated support ticket with notes and attached procurement email. Ticket link: https://redwood.support/89324/inc-2024-5412

Rajiv Kumar: update — procurement responded, asking for vendor tax ID and a scanned W-9. I requested both. will chase.

Marta Gomez: noted. also flagging VAT question: customer is in EU, we need their VAT id for tax-exempt. if missing, VAT will be applied. FYI.

Jessi Chen: closing loop here for now. will re-open thread when AUTH-CODE arrives. :thumbsup:
